component.name: arraw
component.summary: Lightweight RAW photo editor with a real-time GPU preview

description.p: arraw is a lightweight, cross-platform RAW photo editor with a Lightroom-style development workflow: open a folder, edit non-destructively with a real-time GPU preview, and export. It is an editor for developing and culling photos, not a catalogue or digital-asset manager.

ul.li: Non-destructive editing with Lightroom-compatible XMP sidecars
Real-time GPU preview of every adjustment
Colour-managed throughout: linear Rec.2020 working space, soft-proofing, and export to sRGB, Display P3 or Adobe RGB with the ICC profile embedded
Tone curves, white balance, black and white conversion, and three-zone colour grading
Local adjustments through graduated, radial and brush masks, plus clone-based spot removal
Profile-driven lens corrections for distortion, vignetting and chromatic aberration
Edge-aware luminance and colour noise reduction
Culling with ratings and colour labels, and a filterable film strip
Develop presets, copy and paste between photos, and batch export
A command-line interface for headless export and inspection
